description: Find JavaScript files whose fingerprint is similar to the one with this fingerprint_id, above threshold (0 to 1), paginated with limit and offset. exclude_same_scan drops matches from the same scan. Useful for finding variants of one script.

exclude_same_scan.description: Leave out files from the same scan.
exclude_same_scan.title: Exclude Same Scan

fingerprint_id.description: Numeric ID of a JavaScript fingerprint, as listed among a scan's scripts.
fingerprint_id.title: Fingerprint Id

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging; 0 starts at the first result.
offset.title: Offset

name: get_jsfingerprint_similar
title: Get JS Fingerprint Similar
